reason: As a solo CA with just one trainee, our small office fits entirely within the two-seat free pilot, so I have no need to pay ₹12,990 upfront. Given my strict confidentiality standards and past refusal of cloud databases, I would only ever test the free tier before committing a single rupee.
objection: I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
would_change_my_mind: If our firm expands beyond two people with a higher client volume, backed by verifiable proof that client ITR, PAN, and ROC files remain 100% leakproof in our own Drive.
